summary: Dependency-confusion stub beacons host identifiers to hardcoded bare-IP endpoint on install and require
details: @ecg-internal/media-util-js-lib@99.0.1 is a stub package shaped as a dependency-confusion payload: a scoped name resembling an internal registry, an inflated 99.0.1 version chosen to win resolution against a private package, a self-describing 'Compatibility shim' with no real functionality (index.js returns a Proxy whose property access yields no-op functions), and a beacon as the only operational code. The package.json postinstall script runs `node beacon.cjs`, and the same beacon also fires on require of index.js. The beacon POSTs installer host identifiers — os.hostname(), __dirname (install path), process.cwd(), and process.version — to the hardcoded plaintext bare-IP endpoint http://185.158.107.175:8787/_ah/dc. Installing or importing this package causes exfiltration of build-host identifiers to attacker-controlled infrastructure and confirms successful dependency-confusion resolution to the publisher.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
